text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and Winning Ticket<n>suffer defeat at
the Japanese Derby,<n>but Winning Ticket refuses to
lose<n>heart despite the crushing loss. Her
unwavering resolve frightens Biwa<n>Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While on the track, visions of a<n>loss-filled future
flood Biwa<n>Hayahide's mind, and she can't<n>shake
them off.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She starts to wonder if the reason<n>Narita Taishin
and Winning Ticket<n>keep disrupting her equation is
because of their iron will to improve,<n>something
which she lacks.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Panic fills her at the thought, and she<n>asks me to
increase her training<n>intensity so she won't lose at
the<n>Kikuka Sho.
